# Daily Operations and Equipment Dispatch Log
Shift: Day Operations (06:00 - 16:30) | Date: 05/14/2026

## Fleet and Crew Availability
| Crew ID | Lead Technician | Vehicle Unit | Equipment Staged | Trailer Capacity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Crew 4 | Raymond Weaver | Truck 12 | Mini-Excavator E35 (7,800 lb) | 10,000 lb |
| Crew 7 | Raymond Ramos | Truck 18 | Skid Steer S70 (2,800 lb) | 3,500 lb |
| Crew 9 | Jason Ortiz | Truck 22 | Trencher RT45 (4,200 lb) | 6,000 lb |

## Dispatched Work Orders

## Work Order WO-4481: Main Street Water Line Replacement
- Site Address: 1420 N Main St, Oakridge, OH
- Customer Contact: Oakridge Public Works (555-0144)
- Required Arrival Window: 07:15 - 07:45
- Lead Technician Raymond Weaver checked out from yard at 06:40 driving Truck 18.
- Required Task: Trench 180 linear feet along easement to clear collapsed lateral.

## Work Order WO-4482: Valley High School Conduit Trenching
- Site Address: 8800 Campus Meadow Way, Oakridge, OH
- Scope of Work: Install 400 ft electrical conduit across south practice field.
- Lead Technician Jason Ortiz confirmed route clearance via County Road 4.
- Assigned Equipment: Trencher RT45 secured on flatbed trailer behind Truck 22.

## Work Order WO-4483: Commerce Center Parking Lot Grading
- Site Address: 304 Industrial Pkwy, Oakridge, OH
- Scope: Remove 3 inches of compacted gravel and prep subgrade for paving.
- Crew 7 is assigned to haul the Mini-Excavator E35 with Trailer 18 to this location.
- Departure clearance granted by Dispatcher Isabel Haddad at 07:10.
